brief: The 6 remote-work tools high-output teams quietly swear by in 2026.

slots.subtitle: The quiet infrastructure behind the most focused distributed teams of 2026. No noise, only signal.

slots.title: ISSUE
slots.subtitle: A shared source of truth that replaces status meetings with clarity and momentum every single morning.
slots.bodyText: Linear moves teams away from Jira bloat with opinionated speed. Keyboard-first design keeps engineers in flow. Cycles create natural rhythm without micromanagement. It is the operating system for product teams who ship.
slots.calloutBody: Clarity is a substitute for headcount in remote teams.

slots.title: COMMAND
slots.subtitle: One keystroke to open Jira tickets, start Zoom rooms, or run scripts without leaving the keyboard.
slots.bodyText: Raycast turns every macOS machine into a mission control. Extensions replace context switching with instant execution. Teams share custom scripts as internal plugins. It is the invisible layer between intention and action.
slots.calloutBody: Speed is a feature when no one sits beside you.

slots.title: MODERN
slots.subtitle: A terminal rebuilt for collaboration, with shared sessions and AI command suggestions that actually understand context.
slots.bodyText: Warp replaces the black box with a multiplayer canvas. Blocks organize output into shareable notebooks. AI corrects syntax errors before they reach production. Remote DevOps teams finally have a native habitat.
slots.calloutBody: The command line is now a shared workspace.

slots.title: REMOTE
slots.subtitle: Screen sharing built for engineers, with multiple cursors, crystal audio, and zero friction to jump into code together.
slots.bodyText: Tuple recreates the shoulder tap without the shoulder. Two cursors mean true co-ownership of the editor. Drawing tools annotate architecture in real time. It preserves the social craft of programming across time zones.
slots.calloutBody: Quality code is still written by two people, not one.

slots.title: ASYNC
slots.subtitle: Record, edit, and share updates by editing text instead of timelines, making video as malleable as a document.
slots.bodyText: Descript removes the terror of the red record button. Edit out filler words with a single click. Overdub fixes mistakes without re-recording. Distributed teams communicate with personality without sacrificing schedule.
slots.calloutBody: Video becomes documentation when it is editable.

slots.title: FOCUSED
slots.subtitle: Calendar defense that automates focus blocks across time zones, protecting deep work from the entropy of open offices.
slots.bodyText: Notion Calendar syncs availability without exposing your entire schedule. Travel time buffers appear automatically. Focus blocks render as hard stops for Slack and email. It respects the asynchronous contract that remote teams run on.
slots.calloutBody: A protected calendar is a protected team.

slots.ctaBody: High-output teams invest in invisible infrastructure that removes friction before anyone asks for help.
